ios.desc: Glowby Genius is a draw-to-code software creation tool. If you want to quickly and easily develop a web app, just attach your designs, simply draw whatever you want to build, and export your code to JavaScript and Tailwind CSS.

show_hn.title: Show HN: Draw-to-code on Vision Pro with offline mode

quotes.text:
Hi everyone, I built a Vision Pro app that lets you develop simple apps just by drawing on a canvas. You can export code to JavaScript and Tailwind CSS, SwiftUI, Kotlin, or Flutter. The app also supports the offline mode that runs OpenHermes-2.5-Mistral-7B locally on Vision Pro to work without internet.

Here's how it works (demos + instructions): https://github.com/glowbom/glowby/blob/main/GlowbyGenius.md

Try it out and let me know what you think. Thanks!
